title: Ukubekezela Komphefumulo Ohluphekile
intro: Ezincwadini zomlando, kukhona umuntu ogama lakhe lisho ukukhuthazela. Lo muntu wavivinywa ngokulahlekelwa yiyo yonke induduzo yezwe, kodwa wahlala eyinceku ezinikele yoMdali. Phakathi neminyaka yobunzima nokugula ngokomzimba, inhliziyo yalo mphefumulo yahlala igxilile okholweni, inikeza ukukhanya kwethemba kubo bonke ababhekene nobunzima.
clues: Ngangiyinceku ezinikele ka-Allah, ngibusiswe ngengcebo eningi, izingane eziningi, nempilo enhle kakhulu.
Ukuphila kwami ​​kwashintsha lapho ngiphucwa ingcebo yami nomndeni wami, kwangishiya ngingenalutho ngaphandle kokholo lwami.
Ngangihlushwa isifo esihlala isikhathi eside nesibuhlungu esasivivinya imikhawulo yokukhuthazela komuntu.
Phakathi nokuhlupheka kwami, ngenqaba ukukhononda ngeNkosi yami, ngisho nalapho isitha sizama ukungiholela ekuphelelweni yithemba.
Ekugcineni lapho ngibiza iNkosi yami, angizange ngicele ingcebo, kodwa ngavuma nje ukuthi usizi lwalungithinte.
Ngatshelwa ukuthi ngishaye umhlabathi ngonyawo lwami, futhi kuwo kwaphuma umthombo wamanzi abandayo ukuze ngiphulukise umzimba wami futhi ngiqede ukoma kwami.
arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
